@tabler/icons-webfont 3.49.0
  icons/tabler-icons.min.css
  icons/fonts/tabler-icons.woff2
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tabler/icons-webfont

The icon stylesheet also names woff and ttf files. Current browsers request
the woff2 source first, so those extra font files are not vendored.
Source maps referenced by the minified Tabler files are not vendored either.
